title: Premier League Transfer News: Palace, Arsenal, Liverpool Shake-Up
flags: According to **Sky Sports**, Arsenal’s Mikel Arteta and Andrea Berta are in frequent contact with Julian Alvarez, hoping to lure the Atletico Madrid star to the Emirates.
Alvarez’s potential arrival would bolster Arsenal’s attacking options, especially after the rumored talks with Al-Hilal over Gabriel Martinelli, as reported by **BBC**.
